items.title: Withdraw from cleaning subscription (Widerruf)
items.quote: Innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Vertragsschluss können Sie sich ohne Begründung wieder von diesem Vertrag lösen, indem Sie ihn widerrufen.
items.computation: Contract was concluded at the stand on 21.11.2026 (Saturday), confirmed directly, so this is the start of the 14-day withdrawal period. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of conclusion (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts 22.11.2026. 14 days later lands on 05.12.2026 (Saturday). Per § 193 BGB, since the last day falls on a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 07.12.2026. Sending the withdrawal notice by that date suffices (letter itself states 'Maßgeblich ist, dass Sie den Widerruf innerhalb der Frist absenden').

warnings: The letter confirms a doorstep/street-stand sale (Aktionsstand) concluded 21.11.2026; no minimum contract term or notice period for ordinary termination is stated anywhere in the letter, so no 'current_term_end' or 'cancel_by' date could be determined beyond the statutory 14-day withdrawal right.
The letter states that any amounts already paid will be refunded within 14 days after a withdrawal, but this is a company promise, not a deadline the recipient must meet.
